columns.name: SCORE_ID
columns.description: Primary key.

columns.name: SCORE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the scoring engine.

columns.name: SCORE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Long description of the score.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the scoring method is enabled for use.

columns.name: VALID_FROM_DT
columns.description: Low end of valid scoring period.

columns.name: VALID_TO_DT
columns.description: High end of valid scoring period.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_SCHED_ID
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Standard Who column.

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Standard Who column.

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Standard Who column.

columns.name: SECURITY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: JTF_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Code of the object scored on JTF_OBJECTS table.

columns.name: CONCURRENT_PROG_NAME
columns.description: Concurrent program name that generated the score.

columns.name: STATUS_DETERMINATION
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: WEIGHT_REQUIRED
columns.description: Indicate if weights are required in the scoring engine.

columns.name: SCORE_RANGE_LOW
columns.description: Minimum value generated by this scoring engine.

columns.name: SCORE_RANGE_HIGH
columns.description: Maximum value generated by this scoring engine.

columns.name: OUT_OF_RANGE_RULE
columns.description: Rule that indicates what we should do if the value returned by the engine is outside the valid range. We can replace the value with the first value in the range or with the last value in the range.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
